decisions.reason: This perfect binder sits close to the core finishing portfolio, and as a wholesaler-distributed product it costs little to keep listed, so the option stays open while post-pandemic demand from print providers recovers and the sparse evidence leaves its value unresolved.

The fully automatic binder fits the firm's strategic push toward integrated automation, so its upside remains valuable and the low cost of carrying it in the range favors keeping the option rather than abandoning it.

An inline and nearline booklet maker matches the firm's digital print finishing direction and its core bookletmaking offer, so keeping it is cheap while its prospects in the growing digital segment are still uncertain but promising.
